points.description: States that the collision domain diameter decreases (gets smaller/shorter) when the speed is increased.
points.partial_credit: Half if only says it changes or is affected by speed without clear direction.

points.description: States the decrease is by a factor of about 10 (proportional to the speed increase), e.g. 300m to 30m.
points.partial_credit: Half if says it shrinks a lot/proportionally but gives no factor.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying the diameter shrinks by about a factor of 10 (e.g. 300m to 30m), in any wording. Give part marks if the student says it decreases but gives no factor, or gives a vague proportional link. No marks if the student says it increases or stays the same. Extra remarks about minimum frame size or propagation time do not cost marks unless they contradict this.
